text: すき　こそ　ものの　じょうず　なれ…　だな！

structure.jp: すき　こそ　ものの　じょうず　なれ…
structure.en: it is liking a thing that makes you good at it…

patterns.name: 〜こそ
patterns.explanation: こそ puts strong weight on the word before it: 'this, and nothing else'. すき　こそ = 'it is exactly liking it'.

patterns.name: 〜こそ〜なれ
patterns.span: すき　こそ　ものの　じょうず　なれ
patterns.explanation: This is an old proverb in old Japanese, where こそ makes the sentence end in なれ, an old way of saying 'is'; it is not an order. すき　こそ　ものの　じょうず　なれ = 'liking a thing is what makes you good at it'.
